import subprocess
from store import Store
from setup import begin_setup, complete_setup, active_connection

for label, revision in [('HEAD', 'HEAD:cleanup.py'), ('staged', ':cleanup.py')]:
    source = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', revision], text=True)
    namespace = {}
    exec(compile(source, revision, 'exec'), namespace)
    store = Store()
    begin_setup(store, 'w', 'failed')
    begin_setup(store, 'w', 'successful')
    complete_setup(store, 'w', 'successful', 'connection-successful')
    namespace['cleanup_setup'](store, 'w', 'failed')
    print(f'{label}: active_connection={active_connection(store, "w")!r}; failed_pending={"failed" in store.pending}')
PY
